· 「卖价」在这样货现在的行情价上加减，一格一成，最低可以白送，往上不封顶。定得比别家便宜，顾客先买你的；定得贵，卖得慢。打开「停卖」货全收在仓库里，可以设涨到几倍自动开卖。	· "Sell price" is set above or below the good's current market price, 10% a step; the lowest is giving it away and there is no upper limit. Priced below others, customers buy yours first; priced high, it sells slowly. With "Hold" on, the goods all stay in the warehouse, and you can set a multiple at which selling starts by itself.

· 算入股：按现在的估值换新股。卖给公司：公司按行情付钱给你（机器按二手价），账上不够的部分折成新股。从库房提货是按行情从公司买，钱不够的部分从你的持股里折掉。全资时都不算账。	· As a share contribution: exchanged for new shares at the current valuation. Taking goods from the warehouse is a purchase from the company at market price; what you cannot pay is deducted from your shareholding. With full ownership nothing is booked.
